svg.aria-label: Configuration map of two hosts and three Spectrum switches with the matching DSCP priority traffic class PFC ECN and MTU settings on each hop
svg.title: End-to-end lossless RoCE: every hop must agree on the same classes
svg.text: End-to-end lossless RoCE: every hop must agree on the same classes
Host NIC (mlnx_qos, ECN sysfs, cma_roce_tos) <-> Cumulus leaf/spine (nv set qos roce mode lossless) <-> host NIC. One mismatch = silent drops
All links 400G; PFC / ECN / DSCP must match on both ends of every one of them
Rows: MTU | trust | PFC | DSCP map | ECN | scheduling + marking | watchdog. Same class in every box. Common breaks:
- host trusts DSCP, switch trusts PCP (untagged frames -> priority 0 on the switch, no PFC, drops)
- app unmarked (no --tclass / NCCL_IB_TC) -> priority 0 everywhere, 'lossless' never applies
- one spine left in mode lossy -> rx_prio3_discards on hosts while leaf shows pfc 0/0
- MTU 1500 somewhere -> active_mtu 1024 or silent drops (IB transport has no PMTU discovery)
nv show interface swpN qos roce status
